source: On Nuxt 4 with Nitro v3, when {0} is on, error responses carry the {1}, {2} and {3} headers, and JSON error responses also carry {4}. On Nuxt 5, and on Nuxt 4 with {5} off, Nuxt doesn't add these headers to error responses.
